title: Kevin Warsh *JUST* Bailed out the Stock Market HIMSELF
speaker: Kevin Paffrath

macro_themes.view: Warsh's speech signals caution and a focus on employment, so further hikes are less likely; possibly only one hike this year and none in 2027.
5-year breakevens around 2.3-2.35% are well below earlier peaks, so hot CPI/PPI is not a reason to hike.
AI adoption tends to produce a U-shaped employment dip that could be recessionary before new jobs arrive.
Bullish on another euphoric market run, but advises paying down debt and expects rates to go to zero if things go bad later.

calls.reason: Bought the dip on a bounce at $715 as flagged in Alpha report; Warsh comments reduce rate-hike odds, which is bullish for the market.
calls.quote: we mentioned that you should buy the dip if we end up bouncing at $715... Then we actually put six figures on it.

calls.reason: Fewer or no further hikes with stable breakevens would be euphoric for the economy and market; longer term warns of an AI-driven recessionary U-shaped job dip.
calls.quote: think about how bullish that's going to end up being for the economy and the market broadly. Oh my gosh, it's going to be euphoric.
